# Manu Upadhyaya

> Personal website of Manu Upadhyaya, a postdoctoral researcher at Inria Paris and École Polytechnique working on optimization and first-order methods.

## Site

- [About](https://manuupadhyaya.github.io/): Research profile, affiliations, and contact information.
- [Publications](https://manuupadhyaya.github.io/publications/): Research papers and preprints.
- [Software](https://manuupadhyaya.github.io/software/): Optimization research software, including AutoLyap.
- [Teaching](https://manuupadhyaya.github.io/teaching/): Courses and teaching materials.
- [Blog](https://manuupadhyaya.github.io/blog/): Articles on optimization and convergence analysis.
- [Blog feed](https://manuupadhyaya.github.io/feed.xml): Atom feed for published blog posts.


## Blog posts

- [Computer-aided Lyapunov analyses in optimization](https://manuupadhyaya.github.io/blog/computer-aided-lyapunov-analyses-in-optimization/): Computer-aided Lyapunov analyses of gradient methods with inexact gradients and memory using interpolation inequalities and semidefinite feasibility.
